correctness.rationale: The single prescribed pair consists of distinct labelled arcs except for the excluded constant word. Contraction to one labelled arc is reversible up to rotation, including loops and parallel arcs, and lowers just the middle outdegree from q to q−1. Thus BEST gives the tree-count ratio divided by q−1. The rank-one row-Laplacian update is (e_a−e_b)(e_b−e_c)^T; for the grounded minor one subtracts a constant from the full solution to set the root component to zero, and the difference functional is unchanged. The powers of adjacency count overlaps before m=n−1 and A^m is all-ones, so the finite geometric inverse gives (1). The zero-index coefficient is 0 exactly when one of the n-letter end blocks is constant (then one update vector is zero), −2 exactly for alternation, and −1 otherwise. For −1, the absolute residual tail is strictly less than 2/[q(q−1)], which gives a strict gap from both bounds even at q=3. For alternation the coefficients are −2,+2,…, and summation gives (q−1+2(−1/q)^m)/(q²−1); the lower endpoint occurs only at m=1 and alternation cannot attain the upper endpoint. The equality counts and union bound follow. I inspected verify.py and the frozen verification_output.txt, including the 24 ternary order-two cycles and both extremal counts; these are recorded finite corroboration, not an all-orders proof or a fresh run.
